lead_raw_text:
The structure of Hf2Zr2Cu2 (HfZrCu) crystallizes in the hexagonal space group P6_3/mmc (No. 194), with six atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis identifies a close-packed-like local arrangement for all three elements: each Cu, Hf, and Zr center has 12 geometric neighbors within a distance range of 2.9757–3.1728 Å, involving 4 Cu, 4 Hf, and 4 Zr neighbors per center atom. Validated polyhedron-sharing analysis shows 12-vertex Cu, Hf, and Zr coordination polyhedra connected through corner-, edge-, and face-sharing patterns, and the geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component.
